Cheese pies and almond sweets

A small old-school bakery on Nikokleous in the old town, with a couple of tables and Cyprus coffee. On Google, 4.8 stars from 62 reviews.

Bakery

What the bakery makes

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cheese pies

Puff pastry cheese pie, made fresh. 7 Google reviews mention the cheese pies, and guests also took bread with olives and with spinach.

Almond sweets and biscuits

Almond croissant, almond pies shaped like boats and almond cookies. 5 reviews mention the almond croissant, 2 the biscuits.

Cyprus coffee

Cyprus coffee, Nescafé and tea, a short and nostalgic menu. One guest calls Cyprus coffee a good match for the cheese pie.

From the bakery

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Family-run

4 Google reviews mention the owners, 2 call them a friendly couple. One guest calls the place charming and family-run.

Old-school

3 reviews call it an authentic bakery, 4 mention the atmosphere. One guest writes of a distinctive old-school style.

Local baked goods

11 reviews mention the pastries, 2 the local baked goods. One guest walking through the area calls it a must.

On Nikokleous

On Nikokleous in the old town of Nicosia. Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 7:00 to 17:00, Wednesday and Saturday from 7:00 to 14:00. Closed on Sunday.

What guests say

Three of 62 Google reviews, 53 of them with five stars.
